Title: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 PowerShell and CLI are now generally available

Body.Content:
PowerShell and Azure CLI for Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2 filesystem operations are now generally available in all Azure regions. These client libraries include filesystem semantics support for CRUD operations for ADLS Gen2 filesystems, directories, files, and permissions. Customers can now use PowerShell and CLI to automate CI/CD pipelines for big data workloads on ADLS Gen2. In addition to the previously announced SDKs, the general availability of PowerShell and CLI further streamlines our customers’ ability to ingest, manage, and analyze data for ADLS Gen2 to gain insights at cloud scale faster than ever before.

Detailed documentation is available in the links below:

  • PowerShell
  • Azure CLI
